storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
When all things are eroded by twisted flesh, when the everyday life is overturned, a dandelion drifts down upon this wasteland amid the keening noise. 

Reach out your hand. Take hold of her. Love will break through the surface, and anchor you to the one you love once more.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Like what is yet to come but has not yet come to pass. Like what is held in the heart and will never be forgotten.

No matter what form they take, no matter what shape the world assumes, the two beings—utterly different, yet utterly alike—will always arrive at the same answer.

<Italic:"There is someone we want to see again."

"We will stop at nothing to find them... and the world where we can stay by their side."

"If the path there has no end, then we will spend our whole lives walking it. A lifetime measured in searching."

>
Perhaps this is why, amid the screeching, ugly blobs of flesh, a brilliant Silver Core fell into the Keeper's palm.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Saya quickly became a well-liked student. Exceptional capacity for learning and a hunger for knowledge that never seemed to be sated—in Mythag, an Awakener with these qualities was rarer, even, than her unusual state of being.

To everyone's surprise, Saya took a peculiar interest in Ramona. Perhaps it's the bond between Ramona and the Keeper, or perhaps it's the special relationship between Ramona and Dexter—father and daughter, in their own strange way.

Given that Saya's understanding of morality diverges entirely from that of humans, the Academic Affairs Office once offered Ramona special security measures, but she refused.

What the two of them usually talks about, no one knows. But very occasionally, on some warm afternoon, the gentle wind moving across the lawn would join their long, private conversations.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
What exactly is Saya? The key to that answer lies somewhere far beyond reach.

<Italic:"The creature known as Saya manifested in this universe by no coincidence. It is the result of an instinct hardwired into her biology. What that instinct points toward is the ultimate purpose of all life: reproduction. She and her kind are capable of crossing the walls between dimensions, scattering their seeds across the void..."

"...It is theorized that Saya, as an individual, may be an exception even among her own kind. Humanity is a species that has used its intellect to override its instincts. Could that same flaw have been inherited by Saya? In the course of absorbing human ways, the contradictions between emotion and instinct may have dismantled Saya's reproductive drive..."

"—One day, the blessing of what is called love will find her. The white-hot agape will burn within her, and she will be free to wander the world as her true self, restored to her former radiance.">

Should we judge her by morality? Or by the authenticity of her love?

Perhaps none of it has an answer. Carrying with her the unanswerable questions of another world, Saya arrived in this universe by accident, where none of <Italic:that> has happened yet. Led by the answers living in her memories, she moves forward, toward the far shore of what she has forgotten.

She waits for the day the dandelion blooms.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
She is of a species furthest from humanity—and yet, in learning how to become human, she has grown to resemble them even in the places where she contradicts her own nature.

Without love, the world she was meant to create would mean nothing.

With love, the only world worth creating is one where she could stay with her beloved.

Nothing more terrifying. Nothing more cruel. Nothing more innocent. Nothing more radiant.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content:
Hello! ...Is that the right way to say it?
I'm Saya, and... nice to meet you!

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: I'm stuffed. Thanks for the treat!

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Thank you for this gift. I'll keep it safe.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Well? Gotcha, didn't I?

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: I can do stuff like that, you know. Like rearranging or tweaking other creatures' bodies...

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Every living thing is different, so before you start tweaking things, you really have to study them carefully.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Yeah, I've studied the structure of Silver Cores, and I'm starting to understand how Awakeners work.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: It seems like "Silver Cores" are each connected to a will from very far away. How mysterious...

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I've studied Awakener structure quite a lot, so I'd call myself an expert by now. But the "spirituality" inside the Silver Cores... I still don't quite get that part.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: After all my tests, I understand a lot more now. The "spirituality" each Awakener carries—they're all completely different. And, it seems like my Silver Core's spirituality is... "love."

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Yesterday, I found a book called <Italic:The Little Prince> on Lily's bookshelf. It was really good! Do you want to read it?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content:
"<Italic:On one of these stars, my flower is blooming...>"
I feel like you’ve said something like that before.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: The Little Prince says his rose became special because he took care of it... Do you think so?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Hey, Keeper... have you ever loved someone? Have you ever truly missed someone with all your heart?

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: You know dandelions, right? The ones that send their seeds out on the wind. A little seed gets carried far, far away from its homeland... and maybe it lands in a desert where nothing grows at all—not a single blade of grass. I wonder... what might that single, little seed feel...?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: You're not scared of me? Aww... that's no fun...

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: Certain threats out there could bring darkness great enough to destroy this world, right? I know. Professor Doll told me all about it.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Whenever I'm next to you, strange people would just show up and gather around us. I actually prefer it when it was just the two of us in the Domain.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I love good food! And I like people who are kind to me! When someone's gentle with me... it just makes me really happy.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: I don't like people who are rough. They give me a bad feeling...

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Keeper, Link, Awakener. That's how we're connected. You told me about it. I can feel our souls linked together... like a silver thread? Hmm, sounds a bit too complicated...

daily.title: Chat: About Thais
daily.content: Spreading seeds through flesh and blood? Hmm... interesting. I'm kind of curious about her sheep, actually.

daily.title: Chat: About Tinct
daily.content: She's the one who awakened me? She looks really... dazzling. So, did you help her find her sister?

daily.title: Chat: About Winkle
daily.content: Oh? So her kind breeds on new planets by preying on other species. Huh, I see...

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Living things really are full of diversity. I wanna learn so much more!

battle.title: Skill: I
battle.content: I won't let anyone get in our way.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: This is... where a new world begins.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: This is my last gift... to you.
